programmes.t: On the Case: Message In Blood
programmes.d: When police arrive at the scene of a grisly murder they wonder if the victim's dying act would point them to her killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Predator in Deerfield
programmes.d: March 17, 1986 in Deerfield Beach, Florida 5- year-old Stacy Savage happily bounded up the street to the spot where her mother Angela Savage and her little brother met her after school. But when Stacy got there, her mother was nowhere to be found

programmes.t: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programmes.d: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programmes.t: On the Case: The Killer Rang Twice
programmes.d: Linda Donahew, of Arlington Texas, was discovered stabbed to death by her sister one night in June. For nearly two decades the case remained unsolved, until detectives matched DNA from Linda's case with another case a few hundred miles away.

programmes.t: On the Case: Salt in the Wound
programmes.d: An independent young woman starting out in life on her own, becomes the victim of a bizarre and vicious homicide in her apartment.

programmes.t: On the Case: Taken
programmes.d: In the span of 8 months, 3 young girls are kidnapped from their homes and murdered. When their killer strikes again a young girl's heroic actions solves the case.

programmes.t: On the Case: Trapped by Lies
programmes.d: Before police can catch a depraved killer of a 15 year old girl, they must first unravel a puzzling series of lies.

programmes.t: On the Case: Clearing the Docket
programmes.d: A teenager vanishes during a walk to the store on a cold winter night. The next morning, police find her lifeless body in a snowbank six miles away.

programmes.t: On the Case: Snapshot to Murder
programmes.d: A high school student vanishes into thin air during a day studying in the park. Will a photograph from a nearby celebration help solve the case?

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Offer
programmes.d: After coming to the aid of a stranded roommate, Stephanie Brown's car is found abandoned on the interstate and her body is later discovered floating in an irrigation ditch, the victim of sexual assault and murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: One of Us
programmes.d: A young records clerk at the Seattle police department is murdered on her way to work her overnight shift. Can police find the evidence to catch the killer of one of their own?

programmes.t: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
programmes.d: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programmes.d: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Drop of Blood
programmes.d: A single mother is murdered at work. Will a single drop of blood lead police to her killer?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programmes.d: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Daughter's Quest
programmes.d: Victoria Baker was born with visual impairments and put up for adoption. When Victoria became an adult, she never imagined that her nearly 10-year-old quest for her biological mother would ultimately involve her in a heartbreaking murder investigation.

programmes.t: On the Case: Lying in Wait
programmes.d: A young mother goes out for a jog and runs into her killer. Does her teenage daughter hold the clue to solve the case?

programmes.t: On the Case: Deceiving Appearances
programmes.d: Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.

programmes.t: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programmes.d: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
programmes.d: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

programmes.t: On the Case: Path of Tears
programmes.d: A 14-year-old girl is killed while walking her dog on a popular community bike trail.

programmes.t: On the Case: "Precious" Jane Doe
programmes.d: After a young woman is viciously murdered, police launch a two-part investigation; one to find her killer and a second to identify his victim, "Precious" Jane Doe.

programmes.t: On the Case: No Body Two Crimes
programmes.d: A Wilmington, North Carolina, woman is reported missing after she fails to show up for her own birthday celebration. Police never imagined that their investigation would ultimately reveal a gruesome second crime.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Face with No Name
programmes.d: Police have DNA evidence and a videotape of their suspect, yet they still struggle to find a vicious killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Footsteps in the Dark
programmes.d: A beautiful young woman's is murdered in a dark parking lot. Did she know her killer or was she the victim of a deadly predator?

programmes.t: On the Case: Vanished in the Night
programmes.d: When 20 year old Lynsie Ekelund suddenly goes missing in the dead of night, it leaves her mother scrambling for answers.

programmes.t: On the Case: Hidden by Lies
programmes.d: After a college student is found stabbed to death in her off-campus apartment, it may take a second murder to solve her case.

programmes.t: On the Case: Evidence Never Lies
programmes.d: A young woman is found drowned in her bathtub and the evidence at the crime scene indicates her killer was someone she knew and trusted.
